text: Released from a mental institution, Jessica moves with her husband Duncan and their friend Woody to [a rundown farmhouse outside New York|trigger|making a new home], where they find a drifter named Emily squatting and [invite her to stay|rules|it must be let in]. Jessica hears voices and glimpses a silent blonde girl, but [keeps quiet for fear of seeming to relapse|archetypes|Nobody Believes Her]. An old portrait shows Emily resembles Abigail Bishop, [drowned in 1880 and said to rove the island as a vampire|origin|the wronged dead return], who one day [rises from the cove in a Victorian wedding gown|images|water and drowning].
